scope: BufferLine storage, edits, resize, copying, UTF-16 translation and cache only

commands.command: cargo test -p xterm-core --test buffer_line_upstream --test buffer_line_translation --test buffer_line_extended --test buffer_line_differential
cargo clippy -p xterm-core --test buffer_line_upstream --test buffer_line_translation --test buffer_line_extended --test buffer_line_differential -- -D warnings

inspection: Compared source BufferLine.ts and BufferLine.test.ts to line.rs, line_edit.rs, line_text.rs, line_storage_tests.rs and all three upstream assertion test files.
Original file contains 44 BufferLine cases and seven neighboring AttributeData/CellData cases. Baseline counts do not claim all 51 are new Rust BufferLine cases.

Compared packed cell content, fg/bg, width/content/protection/combined masks, UTF-16 text and code, extended words/URL, trimmed lengths, wrapped state, full/range translations and column maps after every generated operation.
Checked strict cleanup threshold and backing allocation behavior by source inspection and passing seeded return-value comparisons.
Verified shared extended mutation and payload identity through fill, load, clone, whole-line and both range-copy paths.

findings.issue: Early BufferLine copy_extended copied values instead of preserving shared ExtendedAttrs identity
findings.resolution: Implementation owner changed storage/copy/load to ExtendedAttrs.share(); independent shared-mutation/payload regression passes

findings.issue: Initial random resize could only shrink, reducing trace diversity
findings.resolution: Oracle now chooses resize lengths zero through 32 independent of current length and compares wrapped/range column results

findings.issue: Shared APC/DCS API edits temporarily prevented compilation
findings.resolution: Owners coordinated their dispatch changes; final focused builds and checks pass

findings.issue: Test default construction triggered Clippy field_reassign_with_default
findings.resolution: Initialize AttributeData in CellData struct expression; focused Clippy passes

limitations: Finite seeded cases are not mathematical proof
Missing Rust cells use Option rather than JavaScript undefined/NaN
The source blank optimization is valid only for genuinely blank lines
